title: Dasakam 72 – Akrūragokul yātrā
description: Akrura’s summons to travel, his devotional journey toward Vrindavana, arrival among Krishna and Balarama, and the welcome that follows.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कंसोऽथ नारदगिरा व्रजवासिनं त्वा-

-माकर्ण्य दीर्णहृदयः स हि गान्दिनेयम् ।

आहूय कार्मुकमखच्छलतो भवन्त-

-मानेतुमेनमहिनोदहिनाथशायिन् ॥ ७२-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Kamsa came to know from sage Narada that Krishna, Devaki's eighth son is living in Gokula. He became scared and upset. He immediately summoned Akrurar, son of Gaandhini to meet Krishna and invite him to his Dhanur yagna festival.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kaṃso’tha nāradagirā vrajavāsinaṃ tvā-

-mākarṇya dīrṇahṛdayaḥ sa hi gāndineyam |

āhūya kārmukamakhacchalato bhavanta-

-mānetumenamahinodahināthaśāyin || 72-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अक्रूर एष भवदङ्घ्रिपरश्चिराय

त्वद्दर्शनाक्षममनाः क्षितिपालभीत्या ।

तस्याज्ञयैव पुनरीक्षितुमुद्यतस्त्वा-

-मानन्दभारमतिभूरितरं बभार ॥ ७२-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Akrurar had always been a devotee of Krishna. He hid his longingness to meet Krishna for fear of Kamsa. When Kamsa himself ordered him to meet Krishna, he was overwhelmed with joy and set out on his chariot to meet Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
akrūra eṣa bhavadaṅghriparaścirāya

tvaddarśanākṣamamanāḥ kṣitipālabhītyā |

tasyājñayaiva punarīkṣitumudyatastvā-

-mānandabhāramatibhūritaraṃ babhāra || 72-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सोऽयं रथेन सुकृती भवतो निवासं

गच्छन् मनोरथगणांस्त्वयि धार्यमाणान् ।

आस्वादयन् मुहुरपायभयेन दैवं

सम्प्रार्थयन् पथि न किञ्चिदपि व्यजानात् ॥ ७२-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The fortunate Akrurar, on his way to Vraja was constantly thinking of Krishna. He was praying continuously that he should not encounter obstacles in meeting Krishna, and so he did not notice anything on the way.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
so’yaṃ rathena sukṛtī bhavato nivāsaṃ

gacchan manorathagaṇāṃstvayi dhāryamāṇān |

āsvādayan muhurapāyabhayena daivaṃ

samprārthayan pathi na kiñcidapi vyajānāt || 72-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
द्रक्ष्यामि वेदशतगीतगतिं पुमांसं

स्प्रक्ष्यामि किंस्विदपिनाम परिष्वजेयम् ।

किं वक्ष्यते स खलु मां क्वनु वीक्षितः स्या-

-दित्थं निनाय स भवन्मयमेव मार्गम् ॥ ७२-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: While vedic texts offer hundreds of ways to reach Bhagwan, Akrurar wondered if, he will be able to see HIM, be able to touch HIM, be able to embrace HIM, be able to talk to HIM. Thinking over these, Akrurar went to vraja assuming Krishna to be present everywhere all along the way.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
drakṣyāmi vedaśatagītagatiṃ pumāṃsaṃ

sprakṣyāmi kiṃsvidapināma pariṣvajeyam |

kiṃ vakṣyate sa khalu māṃ kvanu vīkṣitaḥ syā-

-ditthaṃ nināya sa bhavanmayameva mārgam || 72-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूयः क्रमादभिविशन् भवदङ्घ्रिपूतं

वृन्दावनं हरविरिञ्चसुराभिवन्द्यम् ।

आनन्दमग्न इव लग्न इव प्रमोहे

किं किं दशान्तरमवाप न पङ्कजाक्ष ॥ ७२-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Akrurar reached Brindavana which was sanctified by the holy feet of Krishna and worshipped by Brahma, Parameshwaran and other Gods. He was in a state of unexplainable bliss and ecstasy.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūyaḥ kramādabhiviśan bhavadaṅghripūtaṃ

vṛndāvanaṃ haraviriñcasurābhivandyam |

ānandamagna iva lagna iva pramohe

kiṃ kiṃ daśāntaramavāpa na paṅkajākṣa || 72-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पश्यन्नवन्दत भवद्विहृतिस्थलानि

पांसुष्ववेष्टत भवच्चरणाङ्कितेषु ।

किं ब्रूमहे बहुजना हि तदापि जाता

एवं तु भक्तितरला विरलाः परात्मन् ॥ ७२-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: He worshipped the places where Krishna played. He rolled on the sand where he found Krishna's footprints. At this point, Bhattathiri mentions that among so many devotees in the world, ardent devotees like Akrurar were still rare to find.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
paśyannavandata bhavadvihṛtisthalāni

pāṃsuṣvaveṣṭata bhavaccaraṇāṅkiteṣu |

kiṃ brūmahe bahujanā hi tadāpi jātā

evaṃ tu bhaktitaralā viralāḥ parātman || 72-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सायं स गोपभवनानि भवच्चरित्र-

-गीतामृतप्रसृतकर्णरसायनानि ।

पश्यन् प्रमोदसरितेव किलोह्यमानो

गच्छन् भवद्भवनसन्निधिमन्वयासीत् ॥ ७२-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Akrurar passed by the house of gopikas who were singing about various actions of Krishna. It was like sweet nectar flowing in to his ears which took him to a state of bliss and spiritual joy.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sāyaṃ sa gopabhavanāni bhavaccaritra-

-gītāmṛtaprasṛtakarṇarasāyanāni |

paśyan pramodasariteva kilohyamāno

gacchan bhavadbhavanasannidhimanvayāsīt || 72-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावद्ददर्श पशुदोहविलोकलोलं

भक्तोत्तमागतिमिव प्रतिपालयन्तम् ।

भूमन् भवन्तमयमग्रजवन्तमन्त-

-र्ब्रह्मानुभूतिरससिन्धुमिवोद्वमन्तम् ॥ ७२-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Finally he reached Krishna's house by dusk. Krishna and Balarama were overseeing milking of cows and it appeared as if Krishna was waiting for the devotee's arrival. Krishna was exhibiting the same internal divine feelings and experiences which Akrurar felt about Krishna on his way to Vraja.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvaddadarśa paśudohavilokalolaṃ

bhaktottamāgatimiva pratipālayantam |

bhūman bhavantamayamagrajavantamanta-

-rbrahmānubhūtirasasindhumivodvamantam || 72-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सायन्तनाप्लवविशेषविविक्तगात्रौ

द्वौ पीतनीलरुचिराम्बरलोभनीयौ ।

नातिप्रपञ्चधृतभूषणचारुवेषौ

मन्दस्मितार्द्रवदनौ स युवां ददर्श ॥ ७२-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna and Balarama looked fresh and tidy after evening bath and were decked with less jewellery but looking more beautiful. They wore a peethambaram on hip with a gentle, attractive smile.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sāyantanāplavaviśeṣaviviktagātrau

dvau pītanīlarucirāmbaralobhanīyau |

nātiprapañcadhṛtabhūṣaṇacāruveṣau

mandasmitārdravadanau sa yuvāṃ dadarśa || 72-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
दूराद्रथात् समवरुह्य नमन्तमेन-

-मुत्थाप्य भक्तकुलमौलिमथोपगूहन् ।

हर्षान्मिताक्षरगिरा कुशलानुयोगी

पाणिं प्रगृह्य सबलोऽथ गृहं निनेथ ॥ ७२-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna spotted Akrurar, the crown of the clan of devotees from distance as he got down from the chariot. Akrura, chief of devotees prostrated to Krishna and Balarama. Krishna lifted him with joy, embraced him and enquired his well-being and led him inside the house.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dūrādrathāt samavaruhya namantamena-

-mutthāpya bhaktakulamaulimathopagūhan |

harṣānmitākṣaragirā kuśalānuyogī

pāṇiṃ pragṛhya sabalo’tha gṛhaṃ ninetha || 72-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नन्देन साकममितादरमर्चयित्वा

तं यादवं तदुदितां निशमय्य वार्ताम् ।

गोपेषु भूपतिनिदेशकथां निवेद्य

नानाकथाभिरिह तेन निशामनैषीः ॥ ७२-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna and Nandagopan did honours to Akrurar. Akrurar conveyed the message of Kamsa to them and Krishna communicated the same to the Gopas. Rest of the night, Krishna spent time conversing matters with Akrurar at Gokula.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nandena sākamamitādaramarcayitvā

taṃ yādavaṃ taduditāṃ niśamayya vārtām |

gopeṣu bhūpatinideśakathāṃ nivedya

nānākathābhiriha tena niśāmanaiṣīḥ || 72-11 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
चन्द्रागृहे किमुत चन्द्रभगागृहे नु

राधागृहे नु भवने किमु मैत्रविन्दे ।

धूर्तो विलम्बत इति प्रमदाभिरुच्चै-

-राशङ्कितो निशि मरुत्पुरनाथ पायाः ॥ ७२-१२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
That night Gopikas wondered if Krishna spent time with Chandrai or Chandrabagai or Radha or Mitravrindaa and having fun and forgot the rest of them. 
Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan who is friendly and loved by everyone to protect him from his disease.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
candrāgṛhe kimuta candrabhagāgṛhe nu

rādhāgṛhe nu bhavane kimu maitravinde |

dhūrto vilambata iti pramadābhiruccai-

-rāśaṅkito niśi marutpuranātha pāyāḥ || 72-12 ||
